memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: he said, "Listen to my words: When there is a prophet among you, I, the Lord, reveal myself to them in visions, I speak to them in dreams. But this is not true of my servant Moses; he is faithful in all my house. With him I speak face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the Lord. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?" — Num 12:6-8 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God does not merely rebuke Miriam and Aaron; He lifts up the very servant they tried to tear down. Other prophets received visions and dreams, God says, but with Moses it was different — face to face, plainly, without riddles. Moses held a unique closeness to God, and his critics had failed to honour it.

The heart of God's question is piercing: "Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?" When we speak against those God has appointed and is clearly using, we are not merely having a disagreement — we are touching something God holds dear. Their jealousy had blinded them to the sacredness of what God was doing through their brother.

What strikes me most is God's phrase: "he is faithful in all my house." That is the highest commendation — not that Moses was gifted or eloquent, but that he was faithful. God treasures faithfulness above talent. A quiet, steady, trustworthy servant is precious in His sight.

The book of Hebrews takes this very verse and points it to Jesus. Moses was faithful as a servant in God's house, but Christ is faithful as the Son over God's house. Moses was a shadow; Jesus is the substance. If God so honoured His faithful servant, how much more should we honour and trust His faithful Son, who speaks to us not in riddles but as the very Word made flesh.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you value faithfulness in yourself and others as highly as God does?
2. Have you spoken carelessly against someone God is clearly using?
3. How does seeing Jesus as the faithful Son deepen your trust in Him?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You honour faithfulness. Make me faithful in the place You have given me, and guard my tongue from speaking against Your servants. Help me to trust and honour Christ, Your faithful Son. Amen.
